SGW width/grid

The monospace grid contract, width classes and zone dispatch for terminal emulators.

SGW (SUAS-002) is an East_Asian_Width-style (UAX #11) width classification over the full 64-bit SuperUnicode space (sucs_ex_char_t), folded into an O(1) monospace grid contract (0/1/2 cells + column cursor) for terminal emulators and CJK/ideographic framebuffer consoles.

Width class Grid cells Examples
F (Fullwidth) 2 CJK ideographs, fullwidth forms
H (Halfwidth) 1 U+20A9 ₩
W (Wide) 2 Han ranges (incl. unassigned), Emoji_Presentation
Na (Narrow) 1 U+00A5 ¥
A (Ambiguous) 1 or 2 (context-dependent) U+212B Å, U+01D4
N (Neutral) 1 U+00C5 Å, U+01D3
  • Zone dispatch — Unicode Bridge (curated EAW table), SCP (non-advancing, grid 0), Native SUCS (single cell), ExtSUCS (single cell), Trap/Sentinel (grid 0).
  • Emoji_Presentation — mapped to Wide except Regional_Indicator (U+1F1E6..1F1FF).
  • Tailoring — override hook for per-locale or per-terminal ambiguous resolution.
  • Zero heap allocation — O(1) lookup, suitable for freestanding C99.

Formalized in SUAS-002. Source of truth: docs/suas/SUAS-002-sgw.md.
